title: Setting Up the Combinator Flock
description: Verify the Python environment before defining combinator birds as plain callables.

steps.description: Read the setup note on lines 1-2: every combinator bird will be represented directly as a Python callable with no external libraries.

steps.question: Does this setup cell import any external modules before printing?
steps.answer: No; combinators only need Python's built-in lambda functions and function calls, so line 3 simply prints 'Ready to meet the flock.'
